topic.title: Juniper BGP and BNG Routing Dependencies
topic.scope: Focuses on BGP peering over IS-IS loopbacks and BNG subscriber route injection across the network topology.

dependencies.dependency: Physical / Logical (e.g., ps*, ge-, ae) link up
iBGP / eBGP TCP port 179 session established
BGP route reflection and MP-BGP VPNv4/VPNv6/L2VPN route exchange

item.title: BGP Peer Down over Loopback
item.check: Run `show route <bgp-peer-loopback>`. If missing, troubleshoot IS-IS L1/L2 route leaking or metric constraints before touching BGP configuration.

item.title: Subscriber Prefix / Pseudowire Unreachable
item.check: Verify if the BNG is advertising the subscriber subnet or pseudowire (`ps*`) route into BGP or IS-IS.
item.note: If the pseudowire route is present in BGP/IS-IS but the subscriber still can't pass traffic, the route being advertised doesn't guarantee Layer 2 resolution — verify ARP/subscriber binding on the PE/BNG itself: see routing/arp.xml's bngSubscriberResolution section for `show arp no-resolve interface ps<N>.<unit>` against the PE/BNG candidate devices (197.155.94.100, 197.155.94.138, 41.175.38.42, 41.175.38.43).
